$comment: Hand-curated department blocks. Extraction (pages/permissions/tables) is merged on top by extract.py. Positions are scene units on the flow grid.

departments.name: Sales
departments.blurb: Owns the customer relationship and the start of every deal: leads, the customer master, and the CRFQ that captures what the customer wants to hire or buy. Also raises service tickets to Operations on machines already on hire.

responsibilities.label: Leads management — parking-state pipeline, AI snapshot, background scan to Customer Master
Capture a CRFQ (contract order inquiry) — items, hire window, site, terms
Maintain the Customer Master (partner, contacts, addresses, credit terms)
Confirm order / customer order status after the quotation is accepted
Raise service tickets to Ops — breakdown, replacement, upgrade, full/partial return
My Customers book + Sales Log (activities, follow-ups)
Manager: team report, pipeline funnel, account allocation

departments.asBuiltNote: A plain `sales` rep is scoped to their own book (no `sales.view_all`) and cannot touch Ops data directly — service tickets go through a backend route that stamps the rep as submitter.
departments.targetNote: Sales works with Procurement on machine cost so quoted rates stay above cost.

departments.name: Quotation
departments.blurb: Turns the CRFQ into a priced, approvable offer. Rental lines price off the 3-tier rate card; the quotation climbs an approval ladder, is emailed to the customer, and converts into the Hiring Contract.

responsibilities.label: Price every rental line from the rate card (Lowest / Standard / Highest) — a person picks the tier
Approval ladder: Draft → In Queue → In Progress → Pending Approval → Final Approved
Mark the quotation sent (stage flips to Quotation Sent)
Convert to Hiring Contract — needs Site PIC + delivery address, every rental line rated
Assign lead + assistants; @mention colleagues on the document
Reorder re-approval cascades edited lines into the linked HC

departments.asBuiltNote: Today there is ONE gated transition: Pending Approval → Final Approved requires `quotations.approve` (quotation_manager / sales_manager / admin). Operations does not approve quotations.
departments.targetNote: Target: three layers — assistant prepares, quotation lead reviews, the Operations manager gives final approval (machine availability + transport feasibility).

departments.name: Operations
departments.blurb: Fulfils the contract: binds real machine units to the Hiring Contract, plans delivery and collection jobs, dispatches drivers, processes return / replacement / breakdown tickets, assesses machine condition on return, and publishes the customer PO to Finance.

responsibilities.label: Schedule the HC — bind item units, create the Delivery Order + Job
Delivery Order Job board — assign drivers, split DOs, validate Delivered → Completed
Transport coordination — delivery planning + return collection
Ops tickets: return → Collection DO, replacement → Replacement DO, breakdown → Service_Breakdown DO
Compensation assessment on return (good / compensation required / under inspection)
PO follow-up — flag, chase and publish the customer PO to Finance
Ops notification feed (returns, replacements, upgrades, transit events)

fields: job type: Delivery / Collection / Replacement / Service_Breakdown

departments.asBuiltNote: One `operations` role holds ops_tickets.manage, delivery_jobs.manage, inventory.manage and hiring_contracts.schedule — coordinator, transport planner and storekeeper are the same login today.
departments.targetNote: Target splits the role: transport coordinator (delivery planning + return collection), ops manager (final quotation approval, compensation sign-off).

departments.name: Driver
departments.blurb: The mobile app a driver runs for each Delivery Order: accept the units loaded, photograph them, upload the signed Hiring Contract, mark Delivered, and collect on return.

responsibilities.label: See assigned orders; start transit
Accept / refuse each unit, take unit photos
Upload the signed HC — required before Delivered
Collection flow on return jobs
Driver notifications

departments.asBuiltNote: Gated by `driver.app`; a driver login is force-routed to /driver and sees no back-office page.

departments.name: Finance
departments.blurb: Accounts Receivable: receives the Ops-published customer PO, verifies it against the Hiring Contract in the Document Hub, bills through the Billing Queue and the IVN ladder, handles returns / compensation credit notes, and watches ageing on the AR dashboard.

responsibilities.label: Document Hub — upload → match → cross-check → stamp → publish; Preview & Verify the PO
Billing Queue — every verified contract carries a draft IVN; priority, billing type, progress
Create Invoice — IVN ladder Draft → Approved (junior) → Published (senior) → Sent
PO revision auto-sync into draft IVNs; guarded compare on approved / published
Returns + credit notes for compensation and early returns
AR dashboard — ageing, escalated follow-ups, today's queue
Customer profiles (credit, payment health) + rental calculator

departments.asBuiltNote: Finance-AR is a prototype module on the demo branch: real partner / HC data with overlay tables created by direct DDL. One `finance` role holds ar.view + ar.manage.
departments.targetNote: Target: junior AR approves invoices, senior AR publishes and can undo; Finance and Operations share the PO workspace.

departments.name: Plant
departments.blurb: Keeps the fleet fit: pre-delivery and post-return inspection, servicing, maintenance and repair of machine units. Breakdown jobs from Operations land here; a serviced unit goes back to the Store as available.

responsibilities.label: Pre-delivery inspection before a unit leaves the yard
Post-delivery / return inspection — feeds the compensation assessment
Machine servicing + preventive maintenance (technical_service)
Repair work orders (work_order, work_order_item, fault types)
Service_Breakdown jobs raised by Ops on site
Plant notification feed

departments.asBuiltNote: No Plant screens exist yet. The tables were carried over from the legacy ERP and `plant` is already a notification department, so the seam is ready.
departments.targetNote: Target: Plant owns machine readiness; Ops cannot schedule a unit that failed pre-delivery inspection.

departments.name: Procurement
departments.blurb: Buys and costs the fleet: supplier management, supplier RFQ → purchase order → supplier invoice, and the landed cost of each machine that Sales prices against.

responsibilities.label: Supplier master + item-code ↔ supplier links
Supplier RFQ → Purchase Order (po / delivery / billing status)
Receive supplier invoices; match to PO
Machine cost + purchase value per unit (feeds rate roster with Sales)
Hand received machines to the Store as new item units

departments.asBuiltNote: No Procurement screens exist yet; the legacy tables are mirrored in the inventory schema.
departments.targetNote: Target: Procurement and Sales share the cost-to-rate view so quoted tiers never fall below landed cost.

departments.name: Store / Inventory
departments.blurb: Machine inventory management: the item master (models), item units (serialised machines and where they are), item groups, the rate roster, receiving machines from suppliers, and stock takes.

responsibilities.label: Item Master — item codes with classification labels (stock_type, item_type, is_serialized, whiteboard)
Item Units — every physical machine and its status: IN · RESERVED · OUT · SOLD / SCRAP / LOANED
Item Groups — bundles of item codes (e.g. Cranes) for hire and sale
Rate Roster — 3-tier rental rates per item / group
Receive from supplier / issue / transfer between locations
Stock take cycles + stock adjustments
Whiteboard view of machines (show_in_white_board)

departments.asBuiltNote: Inventory screens are live but held by the `operations` role (`inventory.manage`); there is no separate storekeeper login.
departments.targetNote: Target: a Storekeeper role owns receiving, whiteboard and stock takes; Ops keeps unit binding.
